classification: method-native cross-benchmark; same physical benchmark but unequal training and information budgets

physical_benchmark.test_status_before_unlock: sealed; training/evaluation executable and data path are separate

DeepOHeat_v1.checkpoint: upstream final serialized leaves only; no validation/test selection

Heat3D.scheduler: 10-epoch warmup then cosine to 5e-5 at epoch 200
Heat3D.checkpoint: minimum valid sample-first relative RMSE percent, earliest epoch tie; retain final epoch

comparison_rules.aligned_accuracy: report only where both predictions and references share the identical physical query domain
comparison_rules.official_full_field_direct_comparison: primary high-resolution comparison; both methods on all 571256 official query points
comparison_rules.U_10201_direct_comparison: slice-only; both methods must be evaluated on z=0.15 before numerical comparison
comparison_rules.runtime: direct runtime comparison only after remeasurement on identical hardware; Heat3D-U latency includes reconstruction cost

test_unlock: only after G1 and all preregistered training/checkpoint/config freezes; evaluation-only with no retraining
